text:
Sasha: Quick thread to lock down postmortem follow-ups. We need clearer checkpoints, owner types, and an IC rota so remediations don't slip.
Kevin: Agreed. Last time we had no clear owner after T+5.
Maria: Proposal: define two owner roles: Triage IC (rotating) and Remediation Owner (longer-term). IC coordinates immediately; remediation owner owns deliverables.
Sasha: Checkpoint windows: Window A (T+24h): owner assigned + short RCA; Window B (T+72h): remediation plan + ETA; Window C (T+7d): progress checkpoint; Window D (T+14d): verification + tests; Window E (T+30d): closure + pattern review.
Aj: Ops automation: ops-bot should post a snapshot at each window and mark items stale after 10 days with no updates. Also create a per-incident checklist link.
ops-bot: Scheduled snapshots enabled for thread 1891234567: T+24h, T+72h, T+7d, T+14d, T+30d. Stale threshold=10d.
Priya: IC rota: biweekly rotation among on-call leads, with an "on-call manager" fallback. Require IC handoff note in-thread with brief bullets.
Kevin: Acceptance for action closure: remediation owner confirms fix, attach smoke test URL, update postmortem doc, and mark item DONE on OpsBoard.
Maria: For recurring patterns, at Window E tag Research/Infra and open a pattern ticket with error signatures.
Sasha: I'll circulate a 1-page runbook with the owner matrix, checklists, ops-bot commands, and a pilot list. Volunteers for pilot?
Aj: I'll take week 1.
Priya: I'll take week 2.
Kevin: Happy to join pilot triage.
